title: se-implementation-scratchpad-crestview-financial
content:
Daily scratchpad - Crestview Financial SE implementation
Owner: Avery Chen (SE lead)
Status: working draft - syncing with Marcus/Prod infra this week

Key objectives:
- Deliver Dedicated deployment PoC in Crestview dev account by 2026-03-10
- Validate VPC peering + KMS integration (customer-managed KMS)
- Run perf tests (p99 latency < 120ms for 1-2k rps target) and cost estimate

Today (2026-03-03) quick todos:
- [x] Confirm IAM role names with Crestview (asked via slack on 2026-03-02) -> Marcus to follow up
- [ ] Create CloudFormation template draft for subnets/security groups (BLOCK: missing account number from Crestview)
- [ ] Prototype KMS key alias mapping - need customer CMK ARN
- [ ] Upload initial model bundle to S3 dev bucket and run compatibility check (quantized llm-v1)

Config notes / commands:
- Expected account: CRESTVIEW-DEV (placeholder)
- VPC CIDR suggested: 10.20.0.0/16 (avoid overlap with their corp 10.0.0.0/8)
- Required ports: 443 outbound, 22 only for jumpbox, allow internal cluster ports 10000-20000 for runtime mesh
- KMS: grantEncryptDecrypt to redwood-ops-role@crestview-account
- S3 bucket policy: allow GetObject for role arn:aws:iam::CRESTVIEW-DEV:role/redwood-dedicated-role

CLI snippets (for reference):
- aws s3 cp model.tar.gz s3://crestview-dev-redwood/models/llm-v1/ --profile crestview-dev
- aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/redwood-crestview --target-key-id <CMK-ID> --profile crestview-admin
- terraform import aws_vpc.peering pcx-12345678 --region us-west-2

Integration checklist (rough):
1) Provision VPC/subnets + peering (infra) -> JIRA: SE-4321
2) KMS + S3 access (security) -> need CMK ARN + policies
3) Deploy Redwood Dedicated stack (ops-config PR 128) -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/128
4) Model upload + runtime validation (applied-ml)
5) Perf runs + traces collection -> link to confl: CONFLUENCE-crestview-onboarding-789
6) Rollout plan + canary (console)

Open questions / blockers:
- Crestview legal needs DPA signed before granting production keys (asked legal to confirm timeline, waiting)
- Missing account IDs and CMK ARN from customer (blocked creation of CFN/KMS steps)
- Which model flavor to prioritize for PoC? Product suggests quantized-8bit for cost but customer wants higher fidelity -> discuss with Priya (applied-ml)

Notes from 2026-03-02 call with Crestview (Marcus notes):
- They want all logs pushed to their Splunk instance; need log-forwarder config (we support S3->Splunk via Kinesis)
- Compliance: SOC2 + internal encryption at rest with customer CMK
- Expected throughput ~1k rps steady with peaks to 2k for end-of-day batch workloads

Next steps (assigned):
- Marcus: re-request account IDs + CMK ARN from Crestview IAM contact (due 2026-03-04)
- Priya: pick model variant and run local quantization validation (due 2026-03-06)
- Liam: draft CFN skeleton with placeholders for account/CMK (due 2026-03-05)
- Me (Avery): prepare perf test plan and cost projection template, upload to Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-crestview-onboarding-789)

Quick links/reference:
- JIRA board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-4321
- Ops-config PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-config/pull/128
- Slack channel: #se-crestview (internal)

Random notes to self:
- Consider suggesting a small canary on smaller model for steady-state traffic to validate latency/cost before full rollout
- Keep E2E tests minimal initially: auth, inference, tracing, logs

End of scratchpad (will tidy up into a proper runbook once blockers cleared).
summary: Personal SE scratchpad for Crestview Financial PoC: VPC, KMS, Dedicated stack, perf targets, action items
